# TVL Academy

> Practical AI training program for corporate teams, delivered by TVL Tech. Program practic de training AI pentru echipe corporate.

TVL Academy runs a 3-session, 9-hour program that takes a team from chaotic AI use to a standardized, correct and consistent way of working. It is customized to the client company's real processes, tools and roles, and delivered on-site anywhere in Romania or online. Trainer: Alexandru Dan, CEO of TVL Tech, Generative AI lecturer at ASE Bucharest and creator of the CROTATFC prompting framework. The three sessions cover prompt engineering (CROTATFC), building a personalized AI assistant per role, and an AI Design Sprint for prioritizing automation. Teams leave with a prompt library, per-role AI assistants, a 3–5 item automation plan, audit-ready EU AI Act compliance documentation, individual certificates, and 30 days of email support. Ideal group size is 10–20 participants. Available in Romanian and English.

## Pages
- [Program AI pentru echipe (RO)](https://academy.tvl.tech/ro/): main Romanian landing page — program, sessions, deliverables, FAQ, booking.
- [AI training program (EN)](https://academy.tvl.tech/en/): main English landing page.
- [TVL AI Skills (RO)](https://academy.tvl.tech/ro/skills/): skill-uri Agent reutilizabile de la TVL pentru ChatGPT, Codex, Claude Code și instrumente compatibile Agent Skills. Sursa de instalare este repository-ul GitHub `danlex/tvl-skills`; skill-urile individuale sunt `tvl-write-linkedin-post`, `tvl-design-diagram` și `tvl-ethical-ai-judge`.
- [TVL AI Skills (EN)](https://academy.tvl.tech/en/skills/): reusable Agent Skills by TVL for ChatGPT, Codex, Claude Code and compatible Agent Skills tools. The install source is the GitHub repository `danlex/tvl-skills`; individual skills include `tvl-write-linkedin-post`, `tvl-design-diagram`, and `tvl-ethical-ai-judge`. Install all with `npx skills add danlex/tvl-skills`, or one skill with `npx skills add danlex/tvl-skills --skill tvl-ethical-ai-judge`. Source: https://github.com/danlex/tvl-skills

## Articles
- [EU AI Act: ce trebuie să demonstreze companiile despre angajați (RO)](https://academy.tvl.tech/ro/blog/eu-ai-act-angajati/): explains the "AI literacy" obligation in Article 4 of the EU AI Act (in force since 2 February 2025) — what "sufficient" means, what the law does not require (no specific certificate, no separate fixed fine), and how a company can demonstrate compliance.
- [EU AI Act: what companies must prove about their employees (EN)](https://academy.tvl.tech/en/blog/eu-ai-act-employees/): English version of the EU AI Act / AI literacy article.
- [Blog (RO)](https://academy.tvl.tech/ro/blog/): index of Romanian articles.
- [Blog (EN)](https://academy.tvl.tech/en/blog/): index of English articles.
